resources.string: Allows Writify to detect when a locked app is opened so it can show the unlock screen, and to intercept unauthorised uninstall or device-admin removal attempts.
Writify App Locker — prevents unauthorised uninstallation of the app.
Activating Device Administrator prevents Writify from being uninstalled without first entering your authorisation credential. No other device policies are used.
Deactivating Device Administrator will remove the uninstall protection. Writify can then be removed without any authorisation credential.
